name: Sölderhof
beschreibung: The Hotel Sölderhof is located in the heart of Sölden in the Ötztal valley at an altitude of around 1,368 metres. The traditionally furnished house of the Riml family is situated in a quiet side street in the Waldele district, only about a five-minute walk from the Giggijochbahn. Guests stay in rooms of various categories or in spacious apartments with a kitchen-living area and balcony. Amenities include a breakfast buffet or half board, Wi-Fi throughout the building and a free parking space. A wellness area with sauna, steam bath and whirlpool is available, as is a hotel bar. Admission to the adventure pool of the Freizeit Arena Sölden is included, and there are discounts for the AQUA DOME in Längenfeld. House guests receive the Ötztal Summer Card free of charge. Pets are not allowed.
